value.answer: Tuesday in Denver looks partly sunny with a high around 65, and the other forecasts have it between 64 and 67. Wind is north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph with gusts up to 17. Rain may move in Tuesday evening, about a 30% chance after 3 pm and around 35% by 11 pm. Lows overnight are in the 30s to low 40s, with clouds and some rain.
